title: Persistent Mini Player Dock
summary: A polished persistent mini player dock that keeps playback controls visible while listeners browse deeper media screens.
description: A Spotify-inspired persistent mini player dock for media apps. The component keeps the active track, route status, progress, and transport controls pinned to the bottom while the main screen continues to show editorial browsing content. It includes a rich dark playback state and a lighter offline-downloaded variant so creators can reuse the same interaction pattern across music, podcasts, and saved audio flows.
rationale: The mini player pattern is widely used in top media apps because it preserves playback context without interrupting browsing or discovery.
